signals.usability_note: Shows the side of a gray-sided house and its lawn from the street. The house is partly hidden by a large tree, and the front facade and roof are not visible.

provider_truck.evidence: No commercial work vehicles or trailers are visible on the street or at the property.

professional_landscaping.evidence: The lawn is neatly mowed, with trimmed shrubs and a red mulch bed. This is consistent with homeowner upkeep, and there is no crew or equipment evidence.

signals.notes: Well-kept corner-style lot with a white vinyl fence, mature trees, and a trimmed hedge. A central AC condenser appears to sit at the side of the house, and the front door is not visible from this angle.
